lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical line segments; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, with closer proximity observed at the posterior edge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation identified on the third stripe from the posterior, forming a Y-shape near the dorsal ridge; a secondary bifurcation is visible on the tenth stripe at the dorsal-anterior shoulder transition.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripe 1 (posterior limit) and Stripe 11 (anterior limit) are abbreviated segments; Stripe 11 terminates in the upper third of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: 6 high-contrast white spots arranged in a cluster on the posterior flank and upper hind limb; highest density is in the lower-central quadrant of the haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A group of 3 spots on the lower haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line across the thigh.

other_distinctive_markers: White V-shaped chevron between eyes; two distinct white patches on the ventral neck and throat; white bands present on the distal limb segments above the hooves.
